problem: Bridge the R058 exact hyperbolic survivor to the existing period-1--12 a=6 orbit catalog, then compare restricted periodic-point Fredholm data with finite-volume operators assembled on the same four-h-set domain.

h_sets.word_convention: At phase i the state is the sign pair (sign(q_i),sign(q_{i-1})) after strict membership in X_sign x Y_sign. Canonical words are lexicographically minimal cyclic rotations in the frozen state order.
h_sets.boundary_semantics: Numerical strict-interior classification at 100 decimal digits. A coordinate within the frozen ambiguity threshold of any X or Y endpoint is UNRESOLVED_NEAR_BOUNDARY and fails the numerical bridge gate. This is not interval arithmetic.

development_precheck_disclosure.method: read-only float64 classification inspection by a planning auditor
development_precheck_disclosure.interpretation: R059 C1 is a high-precision confirmation and mechanism audit of a disclosed development observation, not a held-out replication.

catalog.scope: Frozen finite-period numerical all-path catalog. High-precision refinement strengthens local witnesses but is not an interval-certified global completeness theorem.

symbolic_expectations.trace_primitive_count_identity: For every n<=12, trace(A^n)=sum_{d|n} d*P_d(A). The trace table is never compared directly to primitive orbit counts.

operator_block.domain: Disjoint union of the four frozen h-sets, partitioned separately so every h-set boundary is represented exactly.
operator_block.target_boundary_semantics: Half-open target cells inside each closed h-set rectangle; exact sampled hits on any target cell or h-set boundary are counted and must be zero.

claims.C1_exact: The full h-set survivor is exactly conjugate to the four-state subshift by the symbolic contraction theorem, so every primitive A-word has exactly one primitive h-set orbit and the entropy is exactly log(phi).
claims.C1_ledger: As a 100-digit numerical confirmation of a disclosed float64 development observation, the frozen catalog contains an unambiguous numerical witness for every primitive periodic word of the R058 four-state subshift through period 12, with no extra numerically strict h-set-contained word.
claims.C2_supporting: On the same four-h-set domain, restricted periodic-point Fredholm data and two independent finite-volume discretizations exhibit a pre-frozen finite-resolution consistency window.
claims.anti_claim: R059 does not provide interval/Krawczyk root or boundary certification, held-out symbolic replication, global completeness of the H_6 catalog outside the explicit four-h-set survivor, a Markov partition for the full H_6 nonwandering set, continuous operator convergence, or any zeta/Riemann correspondence. The exact conjugacy claim is restricted to the explicitly defined four-h-set survivor and is supplied by the R059 contraction theorem.

failure_rules: C1 and C2 are logically separable. Operator failure cannot rescue a missing symbolic word, and symbolic success cannot be used to hide operator nonconvergence.
No orbit, grid, method, seed, threshold, or dyadic chain may be replaced after production.
If a symbolic word has multiple witnesses, report the multiplicity and downgrade the one-witness bridge; do not choose a preferred orbit after inspection.
If any endpoint ambiguity occurs, retain it as UNRESOLVED_NEAR_BOUNDARY and downgrade numerical membership claims rather than perturbing h-set boundaries.
The disclosed float64 79-orbit/count match is development information. High-precision agreement may confirm it but cannot be described as held-out replication or independent discovery.
If G4 fails, report a common-domain finite-resolution audit with explicit negative gates; never promote it to continuous transfer-operator convergence.
